name: Sensor Top Bar
author: izicubed
description: A dark, modern flat-design top bar shown on every page that displays live telemetry from installed sensors: battery voltage and charge %, Raspberry Pi core temperature, outside temperature, pressure, humidity, current and more. Also shows live Raspberry Pi load - CPU usage, RAM usage and free disk space. Battery percentage is computed from a configurable cell count, per-cell voltage range and pack capacity (mAh). Includes a demo mode so the bar can be exercised on a PC with no hardware attached.
